description: The figure presents two side-by-side bar charts illustrating classification accuracy (in percent) for different model variants/ablations on two datasets, labeled “PHEME” (left panel) and “PolitiFact” (right panel). In both panels, the horizontal axis contains the categorical conditions in the same left-to-right order—“Ours,” “w/o comments,” “w/o text,” “w/o select,” “w/o emotion,” and “w/o cognition”—with labels shown at an angle, while the vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)” and uses a linear scale with tick marks from about 75.0 up to 95.0 at regular 2.5-point intervals. Each category is represented by a single solid-colored bar with a numeric value printed above it; in the PHEME panel the bars read approximately 89.84 (dark maroon, “Ours”), 86.82 (brown, “w/o comments”), 80.10 (olive/khaki, “w/o text”), 88.80 (gray, “w/o select”), 87.34 (teal-blue, “w/o emotion”), and 87.17 (dark blue, “w/o cognition”). In the PolitiFact panel, the corresponding bars read approximately 90.57 (dark maroon, “Ours”), 85.85 (brown, “w/o comments”), 83.02 (olive/khaki, “w/o text”), 89.62 (gray, “w/o select”), 84.91 (teal-blue, “w/o emotion”), and 87.74 (dark blue, “w/o cognition”). The bars are not shown as stacked or grouped within each category beyond the two separate dataset panels, and there is no legend; the panels are visually separated by a vertical dashed divider, with no additional highlighting beyond the value annotations above each bar.
